kpis.description_fr: ~39 725 tours possédées (USA + LatAm + Afrique). Réduction post-cession Philippines + small markets 2024. Pure-play tower REIT.
kpis.description_en: ~39,725 towers owned (USA + LatAm + Africa). Reduction post 2024 Philippines + small market divestitures. Pure-play tower REIT.

kpis.description_fr: ~17 400 tours USA = #3 USA derrière American Tower + Crown Castle. Mix urbain + suburbain. Marges supérieures international.
kpis.description_en: ~17,400 USA towers = #3 USA behind American Tower + Crown Castle. Urban + suburban mix. Higher margins than international.

kpis.description_fr: ~22 325 tours international (Brésil, Argentine, Chile, Colombie, Centroamerica, Afrique du Sud, Tanzanie). Diversification émergents.
kpis.description_en: ~22,325 international towers (Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Central America, South Africa, Tanzania). EM diversification.

kpis.description_fr: Tower Cash Flow Margin ~81 % = très haute opérationnelle. Reflète modèle infrastructure passive (peu de capex/opex variable).
kpis.description_en: Tower Cash Flow Margin ~81% = very high operationally. Reflects passive infrastructure model (low variable capex/opex).

kpis.description_fr: Site Leasing = loyers carriers (T-Mobile, Verizon, AT&T) sur tours. ~95 % du CA. Contrats 5-10 ans avec escalators inflation.
kpis.description_en: Site Leasing = carrier rents (T-Mobile, Verizon, AT&T) on towers. ~95% of revenue. 5-10 year contracts with inflation escalators.
